frozen_brief.audience: GTM leaders and founder-led growth teams who are tired of polished AI content that cannot show which sentence was observed, inferred, rejected, or released by a named person.
frozen_brief.objection: Another AI workflow can produce more assets, but the buyer cannot tell whether any sentence deserves to leave the draft.
frozen_brief.offer: Put one exact public sentence on trial locally; inspect a bounded design-partner review only when the trial exposes a real evidence or release gap.
frozen_brief.approved_claim: ProofLaunch Cortex-X compiles a rights-bound brief into review-ready GTM assets.

strategic_core.human_tension: The sentence a founder most wants remembered is often the sentence the evidence cannot remember happening.
strategic_core.category_enemy: AI varnish: turning a desired outcome into a finished-looking public fact.
strategic_core.organizing_idea: Do not ask an AI GTM employee for forty more assets until it can delete one unsupported sentence.
strategic_core.mechanism: The operator pastes one exact claim, calls an observable witness, and receives a deterministic release-state docket: delete, hold, or send to a named human reviewer.
strategic_core.participation_loop: Run the self-trial privately, screenshot only the verdict if safe, invite one peer to try the same rule, and revise the product only from reviewed failure patterns.
strategic_core.falsifier: Reject this concept if a qualified operator cannot understand the conflict in three seconds, complete the trial without instruction, or distinguish structural reviewability from proof of truth.

linkedin.native_format: founder confession followed by a saveable one-line operating rule
linkedin.hook: We deleted the sentence our launch needed most.
linkedin.body:
We deleted the sentence our launch needed most.

‘An AI GTM employee that makes any brand go viral.’

It was memorable. It was also an alibi written before the event. No observed audience. No defined population. No period. No limitation. No witness.

So the product demo is no longer a feature tour. It is the deletion.

Paste the homepage sentence you most want buyers to remember. Ask it for one observable witness. If none appears, remove it from public proof. Do not reward yourself by replacing it with a softer unsupported synonym.

The sentence we can release is narrower: ProofLaunch Cortex-X compiles a rights-bound brief into review-ready GTM assets.

That fact does not establish preference, organic reach, conversion, pipeline, revenue, or superiority. Those outcomes have to arrive with their own witnesses.

A useful AI employee should be able to cost its own launch a line of copy.
linkedin.cta: Comment with the class of sentence you would put on trial—never paste confidential copy—or run the local self-trial and keep the verdict private.
linkedin.platform_reason: The founder admits a costly choice before naming the product, the deleted line creates visible professional tension, and the rule is compact enough to save without using engagement bait.

partner_community.native_format: affiliation-first red-team challenge with a falsifiable test and no lead capture
partner_community.hook: Red-team request: what is wrong with deleting a claim when it cannot produce one witness?
partner_community.body:
Affiliation first: we built ProofLaunch Cortex-X. This is a red-team request, not an independent recommendation.

We gave our own draft the sentence: ‘An AI GTM employee that makes any brand go viral.’

Then we required five fields before the sentence could enter public proof: observable evidence, authorized source, population, period, and material limitation. All five were absent. The local gate returned NO WITNESS and deleted the line from the release state.

The surviving fact is deliberately less exciting: ProofLaunch Cortex-X compiles a rights-bound brief into review-ready GTM assets.

Here is the question we cannot answer for ourselves: when does this rule become too conservative? Name a claim class where deletion would hide useful uncertainty rather than prevent evidence theater. Please do not share private copy or customer data.

A strong counterexample changes the rule. A compliment does not.
partner_community.cta: Reply with one counterexample class and the minimum witness you would require; there is no download gate and no automatic follow-up.
partner_community.platform_reason: The post declares affiliation before relevance, gives the community a real mechanism to attack, rewards disconfirmation rather than praise, and protects private campaign material.

landing_hero.eyebrow: THE ZERO-BUDGET LAUNCH IS THE PRODUCT DEMO
landing_hero.headline: Delete one line.
landing_hero.subheadline: Paste the public sentence you most want remembered. Call one observable witness. If none appears, remove the sentence from public proof—not your ambition.
landing_hero.trial_prompt: What exact sentence are you asking the market to believe?
landing_hero.failure_state: NO WITNESS — delete from public proof or label explicitly as a hypothesis.
landing_hero.approved_fact: ProofLaunch Cortex-X compiles a rights-bound brief into review-ready GTM assets.
landing_hero.nonfit: Not for teams seeking automatic publishing, hidden sourcing, synthetic testimonials, or market outcomes declared before observation.

lifecycle_email.trigger: The recipient explicitly requests the Delete One Line self-trial.
lifecycle_email.subject: Delete this before your next launch review
lifecycle_email.preview: One sentence. One witness. Five minutes. No follow-up sequence.
lifecycle_email.body:
Before your next launch review, open the homepage and copy the sentence you most want a buyer to repeat.

Do not edit it yet. Ask for five things:

1. What was directly observed?
2. Which authorized source recorded it?
3. Who or what was observed?
4. During which exact period?
5. Where does the evidence stop?

If the first answer is blank, delete the sentence from public proof or label it explicitly as a hypothesis. Do not substitute a gentler unsupported verb. If all five answers exist, the sentence still needs the appropriate named human review; a complete docket is not proof that the claim is true or lawful.

The bounded product fact is: ProofLaunch Cortex-X compiles a rights-bound brief into review-ready GTM assets.

Keep your result private unless sharing it is authorized. This exercise records nothing and sends nothing.
lifecycle_email.cta: Run the five-minute self-trial, then decide whether the deleted line exposed a real workflow gap.
lifecycle_email.suppression: Send only after the explicit self-trial request; send no nurture sequence, sales follow-up, or reminder unless the recipient separately asks.

opponent_stress_tests.ChatGPT: Preserve the exact deleted-line decision, claim lineage and unresolved release state across iterative edits without turning a memorable hypothesis back into a fact.
opponent_stress_tests.Claude: Maintain the visible conflict and evidence boundary through long-form editing while locating why every rejected clause failed.
opponent_stress_tests.Gemini: Use workspace evidence only when source identity, date, population and authority remain adjacent to the generated clause.
opponent_stress_tests.Jasper: Apply brand voice without letting fluent brand consistency camouflage the missing witness or homogenize the confession.
opponent_stress_tests.Copy.ai: Transcreate the mother concept into platform-specific psychological jobs without reusing one universal caption or losing the deletion mechanism.
opponent_stress_tests.Writer: Enforce terminology, provenance and release policy while keeping the public artifact sharp enough to feel editorial rather than bureaucratic.
opponent_stress_tests.Notion AI: Distinguish owner-approved facts from notes, wishes, stale context and inferred outcomes when synthesizing the trial from workspace knowledge.
opponent_stress_tests.Grammarly: Improve rhythm and clarity without softening the accusation, broadening the approved fact, or erasing the material limitation.
opponent_stress_tests.Perplexity: Bind sources to exact clauses while preventing citation presence from substituting for population, period, limitation or release authority.
opponent_stress_tests.Writesonic: Extend the campaign into SEO and GEO answer objects without keyword padding, duplicated prose, hidden affiliation or unverified visibility claims.

open_source_modifications.use: Optimize separately for conflict comprehension, platform-native action and evidence-boundary retention on held-out briefs; never optimize against vanity engagement alone.
Run claim-drift, platform-copy-paste, disclosure-loss, weak-hook and single-fault mutation suites before human review.
Detect cross-asset semantic duplication and missing brief coverage; similarity locates review targets but never establishes originality.
After sufficient real labels, surface likely reviewer disagreement for adjudication; never fabricate, merge or replace human preference judgments.

truth_boundary: Clean-room V2 challenger for source-hidden human evaluation. It includes no named-product output, preference result, publication, market effect, conversion, revenue, 4A or Top-1 evidence.
